correctness.rationale: For the stated synchronous three-color rule, let e(v) be the advance indicator. The new signed edge increment is the old one plus e(v)-e(u): it cannot leave [-1,1], since at old increment +1 the tail advances, and at -1 the head advances. Thus cycle sums persist. If they vanish, integrate to integer heights; updates take the maximum over the closed neighborhood and after two steps the diameter-two rook graph is constant. Minimum-zero heights are confined to {0,1,2}, and the three root phases give distinct colorings. Of these arrays, 2^(mn)-1 use no two. Otherwise the exact row and column supports of zeros determine a full-support binary rectangle (inclusion–exclusion E), and twos occupy an arbitrary nonempty subset of its complementary rectangle. For two rows E(1,u)=1; the binomial sum simplifies to the stated closed form. Inner sums of size O(ru) give O(m²n²) arithmetic, with binomial and power tables precomputed, not a bit bound. For m<=n, each fixed zero/two row typing permits at most 2^r+2^s-1 options per column. Apart from at most 2m extreme typings the bound is 2^(m-2)+3, by r+s<=m and convexity. For m>=6 the normalized contribution is at most 2n(33/64)^n+(57/64)^n; for m<=5 it is at most 3^5(3/4)^n. This proves the uniform asymptotic. An independent spanning-tree exact-lift count and direct binary support check gave 57, 261, 1065, 4149, 2289, 17757 for (2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(2,5),(3,3),(3,4). Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_frozen_math.py 4.
residual_risks: Finite reproduction corroborates only listed cases; the count and uniform limit use all-size arguments. Number of integer operations does not specify their bit cost.

evidence: R_{m,n}=L(K_{m,n}). The minimum-zero condition removes exactly 2^(mn) homomorphisms to the looped three-vertex path, those using only heights 1 and 2. Multiplying the remaining count by three recovers the CCA basin.
In the vacancy/component identity, the induced rook graph on retained cells is the line graph of the bipartite subgraph made of retained edges. Components are its non-isolated edge components.

value.rationale: Labelled rook graphs are a natural infinite diameter-two test family, and basin size is a natural dynamical invariant. The support evaluation gives an exact usable count rather than an exponential state or vacancy census, and shows that short graph distances and fast synchronization conditional on success coexist with an exponentially small basin. The leading constant holds even for arbitrarily thin families with the short dimension at least two.
residual_risks: No basin decomposition for other attractors and no analogous result assumed for general diameter-two graphs.
